title: Live isolated browser-host foundation
objective: Introduce a low-authority live browser-host process behind quntald using selected pinned UI-TARS/Puppeteer implementation material without creating a second MCP or authorization boundary. The host may launch only a dedicated Quntal automation profile on an explicitly supported Chromium-family executable and may expose only a private typed local protocol to quntald; no page network loading, DOM observation, browser actuation, transfer, screenshot exposure, personal-profile attachment, raw CDP exposure, or remote reach is authorized in this grain.

include: a packaged quntal-browser-host process launched and supervised only by Quntal
private bounded framed IPC with protocol/version negotiation, request correlation, cancellation, size limits, and typed failures
dedicated ephemeral Quntal automation profile creation under protected Quntal state with deterministic cleanup and no personal browser data reuse
supported-browser executable discovery and verification with exact path/version/publisher or equivalent integrity evidence where available

browser sandbox enabled and explicit denial of --no-sandbox, remote-debugging TCP listeners, arbitrary user-data-dir, extension inheritance, external protocol handlers, and caller-supplied browser flags
browser and host process supervision with bounded process count, memory/time ceilings where enforceable, parent/session invalidation, crash detection, and kill-on-Quntal-shutdown behavior
server-allocated BrowserEngineId and BrowserProfileId bound to installation/session/policy revision with no caller-selected identity
tests proving the host has no MCP/HTTP/LAN listener and cannot be directly addressed by an AI client
exclude: personal profile or stored credential access

authority_delta.filesystem: A protected Quntal-owned automation profile and bounded browser-host state may be created under Quntal protected local state. No personal browser profile, workspace file, or arbitrary caller path becomes readable/writable.
authority_delta.process: Quntal may launch and supervise one bounded browser-host and its supported browser child process under exact executable/profile policy. No caller-selected executable or flag authority is added.
authority_delta.network: None. Page/network loading remains blocked until SG-000075.
authority_delta.browser: A live isolated browser process may exist, but no navigation, observation, actuation, transfers, personal-profile access, raw CDP, or caller-facing browser tool is authorized.
authority_delta.secrets: No personal browser stores, cookies, credentials, tokens, or unrelated inherited secrets are made available to the host/browser.
authority_delta.approval: No new approval class or reusable approval is introduced.
authority_delta.privileged: None; browser launch must run without elevation.

invariants: quntald remains the authority boundary and the browser host is a replaceable low-authority implementation component
the browser host has no independent MCP/public network control plane
personal browser profiles and caller-selected browser flags are unreachable

acceptance.claim: A real supported browser launches only with a Quntal-owned isolated profile and no personal-profile data or caller-selected launch flags.
The browser host is reachable only through the private bounded Quntal protocol and exposes no MCP, HTTP, LAN, remote-debugging TCP, or other caller-addressable control listener.
Crash, parent exit, lock/logoff/session invalidation, and Quntal shutdown deterministically invalidate browser engine/profile identities and terminate supervised child processes.
Tests prove page loading/network, DOM/AX observation, browser actuation, transfer, screenshot exposure, arbitrary JS/CDP, personal profile, and remote reach remain denied/unreachable.
Exact-head Windows qualification, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, manual excluded-file review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000075: Browser network mediation and real navigation may activate only after the isolated host is canonically qualified.

done_when: A live but network-inert, caller-inert, isolated browser host is canonically qualified behind quntald with no personal-profile or raw control reach.
